name: Hotel Gasthof Purner
beschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Purner is located in the charming village of Thaur, right at the foot of the Nordkette range near Innsbruck. The surrounding Karwendel mountains offer scenic trails through the Thaurer Klamm gorge, while winter brings effortless access to ski areas like Glungezer and Axamer Lizum. Facilities include a restorative wellness area with sauna and an authentic parlour restaurant dedicated to fresh regional cuisine.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Purner in Thaur at the foot of the Nordkette provides traditional family hospitality, a sauna wellness area, regional cuisine, and proximity to Innsbruck.
